class.name: FeatureGenerator
class.brief_description: Feature placement system for decorations, ores, trees, and other structures.
class.description:
[b]FeatureGenerator[/b] handles placement of decorative features and structures after biome terrain is generated. Features include trees, ore veins, rocks, and custom structures placed according to probabilistic rules.
[b]Key Features:[/b] [ul] [li]Rule-based feature placement (trees, ores, rocks, foliage, structures)[/li] [li]Probabilistic spawning with configurable density[/li] [li]Biome-specific feature placement[/li] [li]Height-range filtering (mountains vs valleys)[/li] [li]Cluster generation for ore veins and rock formations[/li] [li]Deterministic placement (reproducible with same seed)[/li] [/ul]
[b]Feature Types:[/b] [ul] [li][b]TREE:[/b] Large vegetation (1-5 blocks tall)[/li] [li][b]ORE_VEIN:[/b] Mineral clusters (varying density)[/li] [li][b]ROCK:[/b] Rock formations and boulders[/li] [li][b]FOLIAGE:[/b] Flowers, grass, small plants[/li] [li][b]STRUCTURE:[/b] Custom structures and decorations[/li] [/ul]
[b]Rule System:[/b] Each feature rule defines: - [b]Type:[/b] What kind of feature (tree, ore, etc.) - [b]Probability:[/b] Chance of spawning (0.0-1.0) - [b]Allowed biomes:[/b] Which biomes allow this feature - [b]Height range:[/b] Min/max Y for placement - [b]Voxel type:[/b] What voxel ID to place - [b]Cluster size:[/b] How many voxels per placement - [b]Spacing:[/b] Minimum distance between features
[b]Typical Usage:[/b] [code] var feature_gen = FeatureGenerator.new()
# Add trees to grasslands (10% chance in height range 5-20) feature_gen.add_tree_rule( 0.1, # 10% probability [0], # biome index 0 (grassland) 5, 20 # height range )
# Add iron ore (30% chance, cluster size 8) feature_gen.add_ore_rule( IRON_VOXEL_ID, # ore type 0.3, # probability 0, 50, # height range 8 # cluster size )
# Add rocks to mountains (20% probability) feature_gen.add_rock_rule( 0.2, [2], # biome index 2 (mountains) 15, 30 )
generator.set_feature_generator(feature_gen) [/code]
[b]Related Classes:[/b] [ul] [li][VoxelGenerator] - Applies features after biome generation[/li] [li][BiomeGenerator] - Defines where features can spawn[/li] [li][Voxel] - Individual voxel representation[/li] [/ul]

method.name: set_seed
method.description:
Sets the random seed for deterministic feature placement.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_seed[/code] - Seed value. Same seed = same feature distribution.
[b]Effect:[/b] Used for position-seeded hashing. Ensures reproducible feature placement.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_seed]

method.name: get_seed
method.description:
Returns the current seed.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_seed]

method.name: add_rule
method.description:
Adds a feature placement rule.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]feature_type[/code] - Type constant (FEATURE_TREE, FEATURE_ORE_VEIN, FEATURE_ROCK, FEATURE_FOLIAGE, FEATURE_STRUCTURE) [code]spawn_probability[/code] - 0.0-1.0. Higher = more frequent. [code]allowed_biomes[/code] - Array of biome indices where this can spawn [code]min_height, max_height[/code] - Y range for placement [code]voxel_type[/code] - Voxel ID to place [code]cluster_size[/code] - Number of voxels in cluster (1 = single block) [code]min_spacing[/code] - Minimum distance to next feature (in blocks)
[b]Example:[/b] [code] feature_gen.add_rule( FeatureGenerator.FEATURE_ORE_VEIN, # Iron ore 0.25, # 25% probability [0, 1, 2], # In biomes 0, 1, 2 0, 100, # Y 0-100 IRON_VOXEL_TYPE, # Place iron 12, # Cluster size 12 16 # Min 16 blocks apart ) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method add_tree_rule], [method add_ore_rule], [method add_rock_rule]

method.name: remove_rule
method.description:
Removes a feature rule by index.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]index[/code] - Rule index (0 to get_rule_count()-1)
[b]See Also:[/b] [method add_rule], [method clear_rules]

method.name: clear_rules
method.description:
Removes all feature rules.
[b]Effect:[/b] No features will be placed until new rules are added.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_rule_count]

method.name: get_rule_count
method.description:
Returns the number of configured rules.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_rule]

method.name: get_rule
method.description:
Returns rule configuration as a dictionary.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]index[/code] - Rule index (0 to get_rule_count()-1)
[b]Return Value:[/b] Dictionary with keys: feature_type, spawn_probability, allowed_biomes, min_height, max_height, voxel_type, cluster_size, min_spacing
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_rule_count]

method.name: add_tree_rule
method.description:
Convenience method to add a tree placement rule.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]probability[/code] - Spawn rate (0.0-1.0) [code]biomes[/code] - Allowed biome indices [code]min_h, max_h[/code] - Height range
[b]Equivalent To:[/b] [code]add_rule(FEATURE_TREE, probability, biomes, min_h, max_h, TREE_VOXEL, 1, 4)[/code]
[b]Example:[/b] [code] # 15% trees in grassland (biome 0) between Y5-Y20 feature_gen.add_tree_rule(0.15, [0], 5, 20) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method add_ore_rule], [method add_rock_rule]

method.name: add_ore_rule
method.description:
Convenience method to add ore vein placement.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]ore_voxel_type[/code] - Ore type ID [code]probability[/code] - Spawn rate [code]min_h, max_h[/code] - Depth range [code]cluster_size[/code] - Size of ore veins
[b]Equivalent To:[/b] [code]add_rule(FEATURE_ORE_VEIN, probability, [], min_h, max_h, ore_voxel_type, cluster_size, 0)[/code]
[b]Example:[/b] [code] # Iron ore: 20% chance, 8-block clusters, Y0-Y60 feature_gen.add_ore_rule(IRON_VOXEL, 0.2, 0, 60, 8)
# Gold ore: 10% chance, Y40-Y100 feature_gen.add_ore_rule(GOLD_VOXEL, 0.1, 40, 100, 12)
# Diamond: 5% chance, Y0-Y50 (rare) feature_gen.add_ore_rule(DIAMOND_VOXEL, 0.05, 0, 50, 4) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method add_tree_rule], [method add_rock_rule]

method.name: add_rock_rule
method.description:
Convenience method to add rock formation placement.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]probability[/code] - Spawn rate [code]biomes[/code] - Allowed biome indices [code]min_h, max_h[/code] - Height range
[b]Example:[/b] [code] # Rocks in mountains (biome 2), Y15-Y40 feature_gen.add_rock_rule(0.25, [2], 15, 40) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method add_tree_rule], [method add_ore_rule]

method.name: add_foliage_rule
method.description:
Convenience method to add foliage (flowers, grass) placement.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]foliage_voxel[/code] - Foliage voxel type [code]probability[/code] - Spawn rate (typically high, 0.3-0.8) [code]biomes[/code] - Allowed biome indices
[b]Example:[/b] [code] # Flowers in grassland (biome 0), 40% density feature_gen.add_foliage_rule(FLOWER_VOXEL, 0.4, [0])
# Mushrooms in forest (biome 1), 20% density feature_gen.add_foliage_rule(MUSHROOM_VOXEL, 0.2, [1]) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method add_tree_rule], [method add_rock_rule]

method.name: should_spawn_at
method.description:
Checks if a feature should spawn at a position based on a rule.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]x, y, z[/code] - World position [code]rule_index[/code] - Rule to check against
[b]Return Value:[/b] true if feature should spawn, false otherwise (checked against probability and height range).
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Safe to call from any thread.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method is_biome_allowed]

method.name: is_biome_allowed
method.description:
Checks if a biome is allowed for a rule.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]biome_index[/code] - Biome index from BiomeGenerator [code]rule_index[/code] - Feature rule index
[b]Return Value:[/b] true if biome allows this feature.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method should_spawn_at]

method.name: get_features_in_region
method.description:
Generates features for a chunk region.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]start_x, start_y, start_z[/code] - Region origin [code]size_x, size_y, size_z[/code] - Region dimensions [code]surface_heights[/code] - Array of Y values for each surface position [code]biome_indices[/code] - Array of biome IDs for each position
[b]Return Value:[/b] Array of feature placement dictionaries with keys: position (Vector3i), feature_type, voxel_type, size
[b]Note:[/b] Called internally during chunk generation. Applies all rules to the region.
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Safe to call from any thread (deterministic).
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_feature_at]

method.name: get_feature_at
method.description:
Checks if a feature should be placed at a specific position.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]x, y, z[/code] - World position [code]surface_height[/code] - Y coordinate of terrain surface [code]biome_index[/code] - Current biome at position
[b]Return Value:[/b] Dictionary if feature should spawn: {position, feature_type, voxel_type, size} Empty dictionary if no feature at this position.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_features_in_region]

method.name: generate_ore_cluster
method.description:
Generates ore cluster positions around a center point.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]center_x, center_y, center_z[/code] - Cluster center [code]cluster_size[/code] - Number of ore blocks in cluster
[b]Return Value:[/b] Array of Vector3i positions to place ore.
[b]Effect:[/b] Creates a randomish cluster pattern around center (deterministic with seed).
[b]Example:[/b] [code] var ore_positions = feature_gen.generate_ore_cluster(50, 30, 50, 12) for pos in ore_positions: generator.set_voxel(pos, IRON_VOXEL) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method add_ore_rule]
